description: It returns the current price and details of the product based on the specified barcode and store name. Price history can also be included optionally. Billing per call: Credits: metered (~0 avg).

history.description: Returns historical price information; this is optional. If historical price information is available, it consumes 1 additional credit.
history.title: history

isExist.description: Is the relevant barcode available at the corresponding store? It does not use up credit.
isExist.title: isExist

marketName.description: Name of the store where the price will be checked (e.g., Özdilekteyim, Migros)
marketName.title: marketName

name: get_api_external_product_of_market
title: Retrieves Only the Relevant Market Price
